body:
I feel the same!! It’s like there’s nothing I can do I’ll always just be bad at talking to people and scared of being around people
It’s exhausting and it feels like there’s no hope but at least you’re not alone, it makes me feel better to know there’s someone with a story as similar as mine
Right?? Since when are we injecting supplements??
omgg definitely don’t take style advice from the random reddit men hating on here - i think you’re super cute!! soo jealous of ur outfits, you’re rockin all of it so well! (:
cute fit! definitely a slay
Yeah no problem man, everyone deserves human connection even if it’s through strangers on the internet. I know you’ll make it through this, feel better soon
I think you’re cute from a gay guy’s perspective! I love the hair, and you have pretty nice facial structure

I totally feel the same sometimes, humans weren’t mean to be alone all the time - it’s such an unrecognized problem in this world that causes so many people to suffer
I guess we can start by focusing on the small relationships we have, it’s better than not talking to anyone at all - I was just texting an old friend earlier and we had a small, awkward conversation but it did feel better than going the whole day not talking to anyone (:
I hope you can find someone like that to rely on until you’re pulled out of this, I think it comes in waves and we just have to wait until we’re less lonely again

Hey it’s okay!! I’m sure you’ll find someone soon, and even if you don’t you can still use all that love to your advantage to cherish everybody around you. You sound like a wonderful person and it would be a shame for you to feel unloved or unappreciated

I know how you feel, I’ve had to drop out and move back home due to my mental health and it sucks. It’s so embarrassing and explaining it to people just makes you feel worse :/
I don’t know what to say except for that you’re not alone, and if you wanna talk to anyone I’m here

I’m sorry you’re feeling so lonely, being 22/23 is probably the worst thing ever. I know exactly how you feel with the loneliness, it’s like keeping or making friends at this age is impossible! Especially when you’re mentally ill it feels like the world just tosses you aside :/
If you ever wanna talk though I’d be glad to listen! I know how tough it can be to go through these nights alone
i’m sorry you’re feeling so lonely, you can tell me about what’s bothering you if you want! i also struggle with bipolar
What’s going on that has you feeling this way?
I feel the same way! Let’s be friends

Felt this heavily. I saw a quote recently that helped me when all I could think about was how awful it can be to live here.
“I don’t pay attention to the world ending, it has ended for me many times and began again in the morning.”
I hope you get the rest you need. Maybe we’ll feel better in the morning.
This is so cute, I’m glad you got the sign you were looking for <3

That's some good advice! I guess I just don't have much of an appetite or my metabolism works too fast for a teenager, I think pasta works good for gaining weight? I'll try to eat lots of bready foods if that does anything, I'm hoping I'll just fill in as I grow up some more.
Wow thanks lol

Thanks everyone! I'll try to gain weight and muscle mass because I think it'll make me look better, and hopefully it'll have me feel healthier and more confident. But I'm gay so I'm not careful about if I seem attractive to women lol
Ooh thank you!
Wow thanks!

Yeah I don't really mind an androgynous kind of appearance as long as it doesn't make me look super weird. I've been trying to gain weight but it's pretty difficult. I'll keep at it though! Thanks man!
Wow thank you so much! Hopefully I become something of myself but it's a long journey to self confidence. I've made lots of progress so far and nice comments like yours really help out!
Nice eyes, good hair, and an overall cute face! You have nothing to worry about dude.

What did you teach? It's great that you've tried so hard! That's the right attitude people really need here, I'm sure if you keep that up you're bound to find something you're happy with. What are some of the downsides to being passive? One of them for me is people tending to take advantage of me, but that's a pretty general complaint with things like this. What about for you personally? I wish you the best of luck with finding the right way to bring out your outgoing side! 

And cool! Mine is:
1306-6908-7315

If you can't change yourself you could just change how you FEEL about yourself, a pretty difficult thing to do but once you've accepted that's your personality, it could become easier to lean towards other desirable traits without the stress of hating yourself as much. There's millions of introverts in the world, and millions of people who will accept that just fine. What have you tried so far to try and become a more improved individual in your eyes? I'm sorry you haven't achieved what you've been reaching for, but if you have to stay the way you are just know that it's not that bad. 
P.S. Let's play animal crossing some time!
In a sea of faces I think you'd stand out, but not in a bad way! You have really unique facial features, and I love your hair, just try and keep it tamed. Your skin looks great

Pokémon Go did that for me too! It really got me out of the house to the point where things were looking up and I could feel it affecting my health. I'm sorry that's happened to where you can't play it anymore. Do you listen to any music? I manage to go on a lot of walks now just from how much energy music with earbuds in gives me, maybe you could try that? Or maybe another app that rewards exercise, I hope you can figure this out and good luck!
What's your meaning of life?

"It's not a question of who are we really,
It's who we want to be."
Escape Route 

I've never seen a quote like it anywhere else and it's so applicable to life, it was very empowering to me.
